_comment: Denylist of OpenCode plugins known NOT to run on V2.
This is a guard, not an inventory of what is installed: it exists so a
V1-only package cannot slip back into the template unnoticed. V1 plugin
implementations do not run in V2 (see the plugin migration guide); renaming
the config entry is not enough, the author must publish a V2 port.
checked = date of the npm registry lookup, latest = version inspected.

@franlol/opencode-md-table-formatter.reason: peer @opencode-ai/plugin >=0.13.7 is the V1 plugin API; V1 implementations do not run in V2

opencode-pty.reason: depends on @opencode-ai/sdk and @opencode-ai/plugin ^1.x, the V1 API
